about: Hero variants of every line, page, prompt, bark and painted word on Ransom's Rest that names Ellis's family or Ellis's own life (the LINES agent, 2026-10-20; the user's rules: Docs/Story.md 'The heroes'). One entry per distinct current text. 'current' is Ellis's text, word for word, and stays Ellis's. 'neutral' is what every other hero reads. 'heroes' holds a hero's own words over the neutral, only where their voice or their things make it better (a hero not listed reads the neutral). 'speaker' is who says it now ('Ellis': the player character, whose caption names the played hero). drop_for_others: Ellis's alone; other heroes skip the line unless they have their own. How the game picks: Story/HeroLines.h (the design: Docs/Pipeline.md once merged; drafted in Saved/Lines/DESIGN.md). Tools/Unreal/create_hero_lines.py writes every entry but the painted ones into /Game/Data/Story/DA_HeroLines: current -> Source (the key, word for word), neutral -> Other (left empty when it equals current), heroes -> Heroes, drop_for_others -> bDropForOthers, speaker -> Speaker (a line said by someone else keeps its words). Change words here, run the script, run Looter.Lines.*. A current must match Ellis's text exactly, or its row never fires.

decisions.about: Main's provisional calls on the five questions (Saved/Lines/DESIGN.md section 7, 2026-10-20), for the user to confirm. Each says where to change it if the user decides otherwise.
decisions.1_cold_open: Kept for every hero (the drafts). Otherwise: a second neutral on the rows the doc lists (Delia's turn-in mission.Main1.turnin.0, the headboard, Ruth's journal, Amos, Aldana, Abel's phase, the Deacon's letter and slip, the barks, the strongbox), and the cold open's camera in C++.

A rename back is those three places.

entries.current:
The night of the robbery. Skiff came up the canyon at dusk, running dark. Lights on Ransom's Point. A shot on the bluff path, then one up top. The Ransom kid drew on the Deacon at the last. Saw it through the glass. Doesn't wash out ten years. Rode the north trail down and round by the rail. Dawn before I got there. Closed the kid's eyes myself. Wasn't sorry.

Last entry. Riding south after them. If the kid's ghost is reading this: I'd have hanged you anyway. Probably.

— R.C.

heroes.Crane:
The night of the robbery. Skiff came up the canyon at dusk, running dark. Lights on Ransom's Point. A shot on the bluff path, then one up top. The old marshal drew on the Deacon at the last. Saw it through the glass. Didn't save the keeper. Didn't save him. Rode the north trail down and round by the rail. Dawn before I got there. Closed his eye myself. The other had a coin on it already. Wasn't sorry.

Last entry. Riding south after them. If the marshal's ghost is reading this: I'd have hanged you anyway. Probably.

heroes.Gauge:
The night of the robbery. Skiff came up the canyon at dusk, running dark. Lights on Ransom's Point. A shot on the bluff path, then one up top. The railroad's iron man drew on the Deacon at the last. Saw it through the glass. Didn't save the keeper. Didn't save it. Rode the north trail down and round by the rail. Dawn before I got there. Shut its lamp off myself. Wasn't sorry.

Last entry. Riding south after them. If whatever's in that iron is reading this: I'd have hanged you anyway. Probably.

— R.C.
heroes.Pike:
The night of the robbery. Skiff came up the canyon at dusk, running dark. Lights on Ransom's Point. A shot on the bluff path, then one up top. The surveyor drew on the Deacon at the last. Saw it through the glass. Didn't save the keeper. Didn't save him. Rode the north trail down and round by the rail. Dawn before I got there. Took his spectacles off and closed his eyes myself. Wasn't sorry.

Last entry. Riding south after them. If the surveyor's ghost is reading this: I'd have hanged you anyway. Probably.

— R.C.

Burn this.

Keeper: A. Ransom. To be settled on the bluff path.
